As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will resume its season tomorrow on Apple TV, with multiple platforms including Apple Maps, Apple Sports, and Apple Fitness+ rolling out a series of related features simultaneously. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns on Apple TV

Apple today highlighted the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs. Toronto FC (7:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Chicago Fire vs. Vancouver Whitecaps FC (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • St. Louis City SC vs. Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Seattle Sounders vs. Portland Timbers (10:30 PM Eastern Time)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs. Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM Eastern Time)
  • LA Galaxy vs. Los Angeles FC (10:15 PM Eastern Time)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple announced that it will launch a range of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode features German football legend Thomas Müller, who "reflects on the effort he put in before his career took off, and shares why he embraces the challenge of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also roll out a number of exclusive playlists curated by stars including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, along with themed playlists from Eastern and Western Conference teams such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, the company will launch "bespoke matchday guides created by MLS clubs, as well as city tours personally written by players, helping users discover great spots to watch the games, local restaurant recommendations, popular city landmarks, and detailed stadium information."

Users of the Apple Sports app can stay up to date with the latest league information, including live scores, league standings, live text commentary, formations, and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are now available free of charge to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide, and Apple will provide exclusive content and exclusive viewing rights to cup competitions and playoffs throughout the season.

For more information on Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please visit this link.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, or can be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a host of popular series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
